text:
Maya P: Hey team — quick sync re: joint webinar with VoltEdge (hardware + CloudMarket listing). Want to confirm speakers, run-of-show, swag shipping, and marketplace announcement timing. Goal: May 18 slot, 45m main + 15m hands-on Q&A.
Kevin M: Love it. Do we have speaker names from VoltEdge yet? Also need marketing blurb for registration page.
Gabi @VoltEdge: Confirmed: Alex (HW lead) + Priya (solutions). They can present the HW perf + integration. We can provide 5 min on hardware architecture and 10 min demo.
Sam R: On Redwood side I'd like Lia to cover model routing and cost controls (10m). I can do the end-to-end demo tying HW + Marketplace deployment (15m).
Lia C: Yep can do. Need to sync on demo script — what dataset + model version are we using?
Maya P: Proposed script: 1) 5m intros/agenda, 2) 10m VoltEdge HW overview, 3) 15m integrated demo (Sam + Alex), 4) 10m Redwood deep dive (Lia) + 5) 5-10m live Q&A. 45m total.
Ethan V: AV/run logistics — where are presenters located? Remote? We'll need local A/V for on-stage partner if in-person.
Gabi @VoltEdge: All remote. We'll send one kit for on-site fallback.
Kevin M: Marketing asks: 1) 1-paragraph blurb (by Wed), 2) 3 bullet speaker bios (by Wed), 3) headshots. Also promo image (1200x628). Can VoltEdge share co-brand assets?
Gabi @VoltEdge: Yes, sending assets to driveshare link: https://drive.voltedge.example/rdw-webinar-assets (shared).
Maya P: SWAG — we should do co-branded pin + sticker pack and a hardware mini keychain for raffle. Who owns shipping?
Sam R: Redwood covers attendee swag fulfillment (we have the fulfillment budget). Need shipping addresses deadline: May 10 for international, May 14 for domestic.
Lia C: For demo infra: recommend model pinned to rwd-2.1-quant on Redwood Dedicated, with KV cache enabled and batch_size=8 in staging. Also need VoltEdge test image (docker) to simulate on-prem hardware calls.
Gabi @VoltEdge: Will provide Docker image + sample dataset (100 queries) by May 5.
Maya P: Rehearsals: propose 2 dry-runs: tech check (presenters + AV) on May 14 11am PT, and full run-through on May 16 9am PT. Can everyone make those?
Ethan V: Confirmed for AV on both. I'll create calendar invites and add OpsBot to auto-remind 24h/1h.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: Dry-run tech check 2024-05-14T11:00:00-07:00, Full run-through 2024-05-16T09:00:00-07:00.
Kevin M: Landing page copy draft: "See how VoltEdge hardware + Redwood Inference deliver sub-20ms inference at scale. Live demo + step-by-step marketplace deploy." I'll drop a draft in #marketing-drafts by EOD.
Maya P: Can someone own the marketplace announcement timing? We need the CloudMarket listing to go live either during or immediately after webinar to capture interest. Prefer during if possible.
Sam R: I'll coordinate with marketplace ops. ETA for listing readiness?
Lia C: Marketplace folks need a 72h lead time after we hand off artifacts (tile, test credentials, sample config). If they get everything by May 12 we can aim to go-live May 18.
Gabi @VoltEdge: VoltEdge can expedite approvals on our side. We'll aim to deliver final tile + docs by May 11.
Maya P: Action items recap: 
- Gabi: headshots, bios, Docker + dataset by May 5 (confirmed)
- Kevin: landing page + promo by Wed (May 8)
- Sam: marketplace coordination + demo script by May 10
- Lia: infra config + staging link by May 10
- Ethan: AV invites + ops runbook by May 12
- Maya: attendee list tracking, registration copy, speakers intro email by May 12
Sam R: Also need a fallback plan: if VoltEdge demo fails, we should have a prerecorded video (2-3 min) and a backup demo using Redwood-only cloud flow. Can someone record the prerec?
Alex (VoltEdge) via Gabi: We can prerecord the HW demo and upload to driveshare by May 13.
Lia C: I'll prepare a Redwood-only fallback script and capture a quick screen recording by May 15.
Kevin M: Webinar registration workflows: add UTM tags, set up automated replay email with CTAs: "Try on CloudMarket" and "Request demo kit". Whoever owns follow-ups?
Maya P: Partnerships will own outbound follow-ups + lead triage within 48h; Sales to do MQL routing.
Ethan V: On the day runbook: 60min pre-check, 15min pre-brief with speakers, staging Slack channel for ops (#webinar-voltedge-live). I'll make the channel and post access.
Maya P: Shipping address for swag drop (Fulfillment): Redwood Ops, 123 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105 — label: VoltEdge Webinar. Everyone confirm.
Sam R: Confirmed. I'll submit PO for swag by EOD.
Kevin M: One final ask: can someone own post-webinar metrics? Registrations -> attendance -> conversion to marketplace listing clicks. We should track via UTM + marketplace analytics.
Lia C: I'll add instrumentation hooks for demo link clicks and the marketplace CTA.
Maya P: Great — thanks all. If no blockers, we'll lock May 18 and proceed. :thumbsup: 
Ethan V: Locked on my side.
Gabi @VoltEdge: VoltEdge locked. Looking forward to it!
Maya P: I'll circle back with calendar invites and a short shared checklist.
Kevin M: Thanks team.
